description: This file is a shell script designed to perform performance tests related to Git repository pack files, especially focusing on multi-pack reuse scenarios. It includes functions for finding pack files, repacking repositories into chunks, and benchmarking clone sizes and behaviors with different reuse configurations.
external_methods: test_description='tests pack performance with multi-pack reuse'

methods.name: find_pack
methods.description: Searches for a pack file containing a specific object hash and returns its filename.

methods.name: repack_into_n_chunks
methods.description: Repackages the Git repository into a specified number of chunks, creating multiple pack files and removing intermediate pack files as needed.
